summary: All five review items addressed; full VM gate and ASCII/non-ASCII Python oracles passed. No commits.
body:
Changed under `crates/vpkg/`: `src/{zip,verify,write}.rs`, `tests/{foundation,package}.rs`, `README.md`, and `TDD.md`.

| Fix / test | Red → green |
|---|---|
| `zip_non_ascii_requires_utf8_flag` | Unflagged `project/é.scene` was incorrectly accepted → rejected; flagged names accepted and header mismatches rejected. |
| `zip_writer_marks_non_ascii_utf8` | Already passed: the writer already sets bit 11 in both headers. Retained as regression coverage. |
| `zip_sharp_s_case_collision` | ß/ẞ collision accepted → rejected by reader and writer. |
| `zip_sharp_s_parent_collision` | ß/ẞ parent-prefix collision accepted → rejected. |
| `included_xml_declaration_whitespace` | Declaration at input cap caused “4125 bytes; limit 4096” → passed for space, tab, CR and LF. Missing referenced assets still fail. |
| `materialx_xml_declaration_whitespace` | Same byte-limit failure → passed through the shared bounded helper. |
| `package_readme_contains_schema_mit_notice` | Schema attribution absent → full MIT notice present, metadata hashes valid, output deterministic. |

Short XML whitespace cases already passed before the fix; padded declarations exposed the stripping defect. Both short and padded cases remain covered. Full red→green evidence is appended to [TDD.md](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/vpkg/crates/vpkg/TDD.md).

Case checks now use `to_lowercase().to_uppercase()`. Central/local name and flag equality enforces the UTF-8 requirement in both headers. README generation includes the notice before hashing, following SREP 6. ASCII-only `%0Nd`/`#` digit matching remains unchanged and is documented as stricter than `refs.py`.

Public API unchanged:

- `read(bytes: &[u8], limits: &Limits) -> Result<Package, Error>`
- `pack(input: &PackInput) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Error>`

No new implementation code borrowed. The notice uses `crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/LICENSE`, verified identical to `/home/admin/src/sr-core/LICENSE`. Existing adaptations remain from `sr_core/vpkg/{archive,manifest,pack,readme,refs}.py`.

Full VM gate exited 0: fmt, clippy with warnings denied, tests, layers, assets and wasm. Tests: **16 foundation + 18 package + 1 doctest passed**, 2 opt-in utilities ignored. Assets: 69 attributed.

Rust-generated ASCII and Unicode packages (`é.scene` reading `données.json`) both passed Python `zipfile.testzip()` and `sr_core.vpkg verify`. Python independently confirmed metadata hashes, the MIT notice and Unicode flags. Oracle generation passed on the VM.

Task completed; locks released. Earlier uncommitted S10 changes remain intact.
